description: One account row of a synthetic UC-1 churn dataset (one JSONL line / one CSV record). Carries the entity to score, its commercial + tenure attributes, the churn label, and — for the TC-4 entity-resolution case — the ground-truth canonical `entity` and `brand` (Contoso siblings share a brand but are distinct entities/accounts). Loaded + validated at the boundary by zetta::load_churn_dataset (src/core/churn_dataset.cpp), where an embedded copy of this schema must be kept in sync.

account_id.description: Stable id of the account — the correct resolution target for the TC-4 check.

brand.description: Parent brand grouping sibling accounts (e.g. "Contoso"). May be empty for a standalone account; siblings sharing a brand must NOT be conflated into one account.

churn_date.description: Date the account churned (ISO-8601), or empty when it did not churn. Post-cutoff by construction — a label, never a feature.

churned.description: The label: true iff the account churned within the horizon after as_of_date.

entity.description: Ground-truth canonical entity/division the account is (e.g. "contoso_freight") — the TC-4 fixture label.

name.description: Display name of the account (e.g. "Contoso Freight").

tenure_days.description: Days since the account started, as of as_of_date.

title: zetta.ChurnAccount
